summary: config.Load reads IGNITION_CSRF_TOKEN and injects it as the X-CSRF-Token header on every request.
reason: Ignition's GraphQL BFF requires an X-CSRF-Token header (from the authed page's meta[name=csrf-token]) in addition to the session cookie; without it the API returns 'User does not exist in the current context'. The generated cookie-auth path only handles the Cookie header, and the spec records the requirement in auth_warnings only, so a regen will NOT reproduce this wiring — re-apply after any generate --force.
validated_outcome: Legacy HTTP path authenticates when both env vars are set; header also settable via config.toml [headers] with env winning.
